title: 약속: 만나다, 늦다, 취소하다
objective: By the end, you can use 10 basic words about plans (약속, 만나다, 늦다, 기다리다, 취소하다, and more) in short messages and conversations with friends.
summary: Ten everyday words for making plans with friends, meeting up, running late, and canceling.

task.title: Use the plan words
task.line: Read each short situation, then choose, fill in, or put the words in order using the words from page 1.

words.exampleMeaning: I have plans with a friend on Saturday.
I'm in front of the station now.
Sorry, I'll be about 10 minutes late.
Take your time. I'll wait for you.
It rained, so I canceled the plans.
I'm really sorry. I can't go today.
It's okay. I'm still at home too.
I'm busy today. Let's meet another time.

exercises: Choose the right word: 친구가 아직 안 와요. 저는 식당에서 친구를 (기다려요 / 늦어요).
Choose the right word for each situation: ① 머리가 아파요. 그래서 내일 영화 약속을 (취소했어요 / 만났어요). ② A: 지금 가요. 5분만 기다려 주세요. B: (괜찮아요 / 늦어요). 천천히 오세요.
Fill in the blank with 늦다 in the past tense: 아침에 늦게 일어났어요. 그래서 회사에 ____.
Fill in the blank (A wants to know if B is free): A: 이번 주말에 ____ 있어요? B: 네, 일요일에 괜찮아요.
Fill in the two blanks (B says no politely): A: 내일 같이 점심 먹어요. B: ____. 내일은 바빠요. ____ 같이 먹어요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 앞 / 만나요 / 도서관 / 에서
